info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Listing API enables businesses to access detailed information about their loyalty program partners. This API allows users to retrieve a curated list of loyalty partners, including essential attributes such as partner names, alignment with loyalty programs, and relevant offers. Typically utilized by marketing teams and customer relationship managers, this API facilitates improved customer engagement through targeted promotions and partnerships. Developers can leverage this resource to enhance customer loyalty strategies and streamline partner management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current list of loyalty partners available in the system. You can use this data to analyze or display the partners associated with the loyalty program.
